summary: Bridges patrol and health to tower-defence state: damage the base on arrival, grant currency on death.
overview: Drop it on an enemy prefab alongside a patrol set to Once and a Health component. It reports to the game manager when the enemy reaches the base or dies. It also needs a collider of some kind, because that is what tower targeting finds.
useCases: Enemy tiers differing only by reward and base damage.
Any enemy that walks a fixed route to a goal.

params.tuning: What reaching the end costs the player. A leaker that costs nothing removes the tension.
The economy's main lever: too generous and towers outpace the waves.

gotchas.title: It needs a collider, a Health and a patrol
gotchas.body: Three separate components. Missing the collider is the quiet one: the enemy walks the route and no tower ever sees it.

gotchas.title: Patrol mode must be Once
gotchas.body: On Loop it walks back to the start instead of reaching the base, and the wave never ends.
